name: Peyote
summary: Peyote is a small, spineless cactus that contains mescaline as its primary active chemical. It has a long history of use among the natives of Northern Mexico and Southwestern United States.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: It has been used for over 5,000 years by Indigenous peoples of the Americas for ceremonial, spiritual, and folk medicine purposes.

sideEffects.text: A study published in 2007 found no evidence of long-term cognitive problems related to peyote use in Native American Church ceremonies, but researchers stressed their results may not apply to those who use peyote in other contexts.

summaryZh: 烏羽玉（學名：Lophophora williamsii），音譯配有特（英語：Peyote），又稱作威廉斯氏仙人球，俗稱無刺的仙人掌，是一種細小及無刺的仙人掌。它們原產於美國德克薩斯州西南部至墨西哥，主要在奇瓦瓦沙漠、塔毛利帕斯州及聖路易斯波托西州生長。

pharmacology.en: Its main active compound is mescaline, which acts as an agonist at serotonin 5-HT2A receptors. The cactus also contains many other alkaloids in smaller amounts.
pharmacology.zh: 它的主要活性成分是麥司卡林，作用為血清素 5-HT2A 受體促效劑。這種仙人掌還含有許多其他含量較少的生物鹼。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它的主要活性成分是麦司卡林，作用为血清素 5-HT2A 受体促效剂。这种仙人掌还含有许多其他含量较少的生物碱。

fact.en: Peyote grows extremely slowly, taking many years to reach flowering size, which is one reason wild populations are now under pressure. Spanish records of its ceremonial use go back to the sixteenth century.
fact.zh: 烏羽玉生長極為緩慢，要長到開花大小需時多年，這也是野生族群如今面臨壓力的原因之一。西班牙人關於它用於儀式的記載可追溯到十六世紀。
fact.zhHans: 乌羽玉生长极为缓慢，要长到开花大小需时多年，这也是野生族群如今面临压力的原因之一。西班牙人关于它用于仪式的记载可追溯到十六世纪。
